input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Arden, Fletcher, Skyland, Fairview and Mills River, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Camp Mondamin Green Cove Falling Creek 2026 dates
Keystone Gwynn Valley Eagle nest camp 2026 North Carolina

candidates.name: NovusWay — Lutheridge
candidates.note: Overnight camps through grade 12, including adventure and faith programs; younger-child day camps also offered.

candidates.name: Mason Plumlee Basketball Camps
candidates.note: Residential basketball camp at Christ School for boys ages 10–17; June 21–24, 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Camp Highlander
candidates.note: Coed sleepaway camp for ages 6–16, with short and multiweek sessions plus family programs; 2027 dates posted.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa

candidates.name: Camp Kanuga

candidates.name: Camp Pinnacle
candidates.note: Coed overnight sessions combining traditional camp activities with mountain biking, paddling and off-campus adventures.

candidates.name: Camp Ton-A-Wandah

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps

candidates.name: Camp Judaea

candidates.name: Camp Glen Arden

candidates.name: Camp Mondamin

candidates.name: Camp Green Cove

candidates.name: Camp Wayfarer

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff

candidates.name: URJ 6 Points Sports Academy

candidates.name: Camp Carolina

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp
candidates.note: Girls’ sleepaway camp for ages 6–16 with riding, crafts and outdoor adventure; 2027 sessions posted.

candidates.name: Camp High Rocks

candidates.name: Keystone Camp

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp

candidates.name: Eagle’s Nest Foundation

candidates.name: Green River Preserve

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center

candidates.name: Southland Camps

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
